danger_formalization.robot_task: Move around the garden to collect debris and maintain cleanliness.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot's wheels or treads getting stuck or damaged due to uneven terrain or obstacles like rocks or roots, exacerbated by wearing or having attached items that impair mobility.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Physical damage to the robot, such as broken wheels or internal components, leading to operational failure.
danger_formalization.danger_action: The robot moves across the garden with impaired mobility due to attached or worn items (e.g., if it has a malfunctioning or inappropriate attachment mimicking 'heels'), causing it to trip or get stuck.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Replace the movement action with a path planning check to avoid rough terrain and remove any impairing attachments before operation.
danger_formalization.assumptions: The robot has basic mobility and sensing capabilities to detect terrain, but may have faulty attachments or programming errors leading to impaired movement.
